name: @kiwa-lab/perf-harness
description: Generic performance harness — p10/p50/p95/p99 measurement + regression detection (bootstrap CI on p10 delta, floor measured from harness resolution) + baseline persistence + 3-layer harness (serial + concurrent + memory) + strict mode (iter 400 + CI 99% + p10 delta 10%) + 38 package coverage + 14-axis release gate integration + detectRegressionStrict + runPerf3LayerStrict

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --testTimeout 30000
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --testTimeout 30000 --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/**/*.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/types.js' && node ../../scripts/record-artifact-inputs.mjs coverage
